## Aion 3.0 Mini API

Aion 3.0 Mini is a large language model by Aion Labs, available on the Venice API as `aion-labs-aion-3-0-mini`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Aion 3.0 Mini is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the DeepSeek family of models. Multiple specialized models collaborate on each response to produce stronger narrative structure and more compelling tension and conflict at lower cost. It handles mature and darker themes with nuance and supports tool calling for richer interactive fiction.

### Aion 3.0 Mini API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aion-labs-aion-3-0-mini` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.875 / $1.75 per 1M |

### Aion 3.0 Mini specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Aion Labs |
| Released | Jul 8, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Aion 3.0 Mini API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "aion-labs-aion-3-0-mini"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "aion-labs-aion-3-0-mini",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
